claim_scores.rationale: Provides a complete offline `DummyLM` program with signature, metric, dataset, one valid completion, one malformed completion, and a call to `bootstrap_trace_data`.
Uses `raise_on_error=False`, then accesses `rows[1]` and prints row types, demonstrating the malformed case is kept in returned rows rather than dropped.
Identifies the bad row as `FailedPrediction` and asserts `completion_text == "not json at all"`.
Prints the failed row trace length and asserts `len(rows[1]["trace"]) > 0`, confirming trace data is preserved.
Inspects `bad.format_reward` and asserts it is not `None` as the score-like field on the failed parse.
